summary: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VII (HVII) filed an 8-K disclosing a Second Omnibus Amendment to its Business Combination Agreement and Promissory Note with ONE Nuclear Energy LLC. The amendment extends the outside date for closing the business combination from June 30, 2026, to August 15, 2026, and similarly extends the promissory note maturity. The maximum principal amount of loan advances under the note is increased from $300,000 to $316,975 for third-party expenses. No price per share, premium, or advisor is mentioned. As a SPAC, HVII is pursuing a de-SPAC transaction. Watch for shareholder vote and regulatory clearance ahead of the new deadline.
